# Doña Alicia Tampa

> Cuban Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Ropa vieja, yuca bites with guava sauce and snapper over lemon-cilantro risotto, brought to Linebaugh Avenue from the Doña Alicia that opened in Havana in 2017.

- Phone: (813) 336-4850
- Address: 9664 W Linebaugh Ave, Tampa, FL 33626
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Dine at the table; Cafe and sweets; Order online
- Rating: 4.7 from 161 Google reviews
